insights: Card-based modular system with consistent panel styling: subtle gradients from border to surface-75, rounded corners (--radius-lg to --radius-xl), and hover shadow transitions create a cohesive visual language across features, examples, and community sections.

Generous whitespace strategy: sections breathe with py-16 to py-24 spacing, and the layout avoids visual clutter by using a clean white background (bg-surface-75, bg-background) with minimal color accents (green for CTAs, subtle gradients for testimonials).

Responsive grid shifts gracefully: 12-column desktop grid (grid-cols-12) collapses to 2 columns on tablet (sm:grid-cols-2) and single column on mobile, with components like the feature grid using col-span-6 to col-span-3 to create asymmetric yet balanced layouts.
